jei.tacz_camo_armor.battery: Recharges a night vision device, loose or mounted on a helmet.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.camo: A full set of one color shrinks mob detection range by %s%% (%s%% while sneaking).
jei.tacz_camo_armor.detach: To remove an attachment, put the helmet alone in a crafting grid.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.gas_filter: Refills a gas mask, loose or mounted on a helmet.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.gas_mask: Attach to any helmet in a crafting grid. Blocks poison, wither and dragon's breath. A filter lasts %s seconds of blocked effects; refill it with a filter.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.gpnvg18: Four white-phosphor tubes with a wide panoramic view.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.gpnvg18_green: Four green-phosphor tubes with a wide panoramic view.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.grenade.flashbang: Goes off 1.5 s after the throw. The flash is strongest up close and when you look straight at it; anything behind a wall is safe. Players see a white screen, mobs lose their target and slow down.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.grenade.frag_grenade: Explodes 3 s after the throw. Hurts everything nearby but never breaks blocks.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.grenade.he_grenade: Explodes 3 s after the throw and destroys blocks like TNT.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.grenade.smoke_grenad: Starts smoking 2 s after the throw. Mobs can't see anyone inside the cloud or through it. A thermal imager still sees living things in the smoke.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.grenade_throw: Right-click to throw. Grenades bounce off walls and floors and go off on a timer.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.heavy: Each heavy piece slows you down by %s%%.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.mask_fits: The helmet accepts a gas mask.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.nvg: Attach to a US, Ratnik, SWAT or CT helmet in a crafting grid. Press %s to flip it down for night vision. A battery lasts %s seconds; recharge it with a battery in a crafting grid.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.nvg_fits: The helmet accepts a night vision device and a gas mask.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.protection: Bullet protection in the hit zone: light %s%%, medium %s%%, heavy %s%%. Armor-piercing ammo lowers it.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.protection_single: Bullet protection in the hit zone: %s%%. Armor-piercing ammo lowers it.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.pvs14: Single green-phosphor tube with a narrow field of view.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.thermal: White-hot thermal imager: living creatures in your line of sight glow, even through camouflage.
jei.tacz_camo_armor.zones: Zones: helmet covers headshots, chest piece the torso, leggings the legs, boots the feet.
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.camo: Full set camouflage: -%s%% detection range (-%s%% sneaking)
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.camo_biome.ghill: Strongest camo in snowy biomes, weak elsewhere
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.camo_biome.ru_em: Best in forests, taiga and plains
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.camo_biome.us_de: Best in deserts, badlands and beaches
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.camo_biome.us_gr: Works the same in every biome
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.camo_biome.us_mu: Best in forests, plains and savannas
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.camo_biome.us_sn: Only works well in snowy biomes
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.camo_biome.us_wo: Best in forests, jungles and swamps
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.device.attach_hi: Combine with a helmet in a crafting grid to attach
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.device.mask_effe: Blocks poison, wither and dragon's breath
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.device.nvg_helme: Fits US, Ratnik, SWAT and CT helmets
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.grenade.flashban: Blinds everyone who looks at it; walls protect
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.grenade.frag_gre: Explodes after 3 s without breaking blocks
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.grenade.he_grena: Explodes after 3 s and breaks blocks
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.grenade.smoke_gr: Thick smoke that mobs can't see through
tooltip.tacz_camo_armor.helmet.detach_hi: Put the helmet alone in a crafting grid to detach
